lightsheetZarrPyramid.name: label
lightsheetZarrPyramid.documentation: Human-readable name for this pyramid, shown in a manager UI. Empty allowed.

lightsheetZarrPyramid.name: pyramid_name
lightsheetZarrPyramid.documentation: The NGFF multiscales.name from the source store, if any. Descriptive.

lightsheetZarrPyramid.name: pyramid_type
lightsheetZarrPyramid.documentation: The NGFF multiscales.type field, verbatim. Descriptive only.

lightsheetZarrPyramid.name: axes_order
lightsheetZarrPyramid.documentation: The axis order carried in every child level (NGFF convention, e.g. 'tczyx', 'czyx', 'zyx'). Every child level uses this order.

lightsheetZarrPyramid.name: axes_units
lightsheetZarrPyramid.documentation: Per-axis physical unit strings, aligned with axes_order. Stored as a cellstr in MATLAB / list of strings in JSON.

lightsheetZarrPyramid.name: channel_names
lightsheetZarrPyramid.documentation: Display names of the channels, in the order of the 'c' axis. Empty when there are no channels.

lightsheetZarrPyramid.name: n_channels
lightsheetZarrPyramid.documentation: Convenience count; equals the length of channel_names when set. Describes the source volume, not the ladder.

lightsheetZarrPyramid.name: shape_level0
lightsheetZarrPyramid.documentation: Shape of the finest resolution array, in axes_order. Source-volume intrinsic.

lightsheetZarrPyramid.name: voxel_size_level0
lightsheetZarrPyramid.documentation: Per-axis voxel size at level 0, in voxel_size_units.

lightsheetZarrPyramid.name: voxel_size_units
lightsheetZarrPyramid.documentation: The unit that voxel_size_level0 and each child level's voxel_size are expressed in.

lightsheetZarrPyramid.name: translation_level0
lightsheetZarrPyramid.documentation: Per-axis translation at level 0, in voxel_size_units.

lightsheetZarrPyramid.name: dtype
lightsheetZarrPyramid.documentation: The array dtype string as written in NGFF .zarray (e.g. '<u2'). Every level shares it.

lightsheetZarrPyramid.name: pipeline_version
lightsheetZarrPyramid.documentation: Identifier of the pipeline that produced this pyramid.

lightsheetZarrPyramid.name: byte_order
lightsheetZarrPyramid.documentation: Byte order used when the child level chunks were written into the chunk.bin_# file series: 'little' or 'big'.
